svg.title: The Gate: How It Decides One Action
svg.desc: A UML sequence diagram, read top to bottom, of the Book-Keeper handling a supplier invoice, with five lifelines: the agent runtime, the proposer, the Gate, the agent MCP gateway and Xero. A supplier invoice arrives at the agent runtime, which asks the proposer to propose one action; the proposer returns an action. The agent runtime asks the Gate to decide, and the Gate returns allow, hold or refuse. Then one of three alternatives. Allow, to record a bill: the agent runtime asks the agent MCP gateway to create the bill, at most once, and the gateway creates it in Xero. Hold, to pay a bill: a note says an approval waits for the Operator. Refuse, to delete a bill, which no rule matches: a note says it is refused and recorded. Every step is recorded before the next.
